## Lab & throughput observability
- #3674 — the throughput tick names a long park, an unread host, a never-run lane and a rising open count.
- #3810 — the tick reports Codex headroom on a Claude-limited host.
- #3736 — the host observer reports launchd, cron and receipts runs on the bus.
- #3417 — the alert-channel liveness verdict is recorded in a projection.
- #3728 — typed gateway reads: workflow runs, jobs, log tails, artifacts, PR text, releases.

## Verification & delegation
- #3767 — I9 prompt replaced with a code task plus a Layer-1 test.
- #3563 — node_dod_verify names contract_in_another_repo.
- #3739 — dod_verify refuses evidence bound to criteria the ticket no longer carries.
- #3275 — the attempt record accepts and drops six forthcoming attempt lineage keys.
- #2980 — companion seam for the PR landing workflow.

## Effect fixes
- #2900 — the deploy effect publishes the rebuild command and returns, avoiding the 600 s dispatch deadline.
- #3815 — rebase pushes only the PR head ref; polish dispatch runs off the kernel loop.

## Core fixes & guards
- #1361 — the heartbeat loop logs previously silent exception catches.
- #1337 — command-category handler_routing entries now require event_model.
- #1577 — release sync-main pushes as the onexbot-occ-writer app identity.
- #1579 — validate-docs routes same-repo PRs to self-hosted runners.
- #1014 — HANDOFF_NUDGE bit added to EnumHookBit.

## CI & tooling
- #1028 — core workflow runner routing standardized.
- #1951 — boundary validation repointed at omnibase_core.
- #1016 — caller added for merge_group skip-token re-scan.
- #3786 — the pr-title check runs omnimarket's own node.
- #2920 — local pre-commit validators scoped to staged files.

## Dependencies
- #1667, #1321 — actions-group bumps with two and three updates.

## SPI & protocol cleanup
- #1471 — single canonical ProtocolSemVer; circular import removed.
- #170 — ProtocolDomainPlugin moved into omnibase_spi.
- #32 — node protocol tests added; event bus layer separation fixed.
- #123 — consul references removed; snapshot regenerated.
- #257 — stray topic literals relocated into the SPI event registry.
- #1253 — dead onex.runtime.intents topic and intent-publisher path deleted.
